text: 'The 15th edition of the Tour of Oman International Cycling Race will begin on February 6, 2026 organised by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Youth in cooperation with Oman Cycling Association', with a five-stage route 'opening with Muscat Classic' and 18 international teams; the article adds that the race 'supports tourism promotion and economic diversification by drawing international attention to destinations across several governorates'.
short: Tour of Oman 2026 organised by Oman's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Youth

source.name: Muscat Daily - Tour of Oman 2026 to begin on Feb 6
